description: Create a new stream. You can create stream for pre-recorded videos or live scene stream (supports pre-recorded videos too). Live scene is used for more complex setups to include features like overlays, layouts, multiple inputs, and so on. Afterwards, use stream_update to set its quality and framerate (a new stream has none, and cannot start without them), stream_add_output to link destination, scene_* to manage linked scene and playlist_* to manage playlists linked to the stream.
name: stream_create
title: Create stream
